title: TipPool: nightly tip-outs without the math
description: Split the night's tips by hours worked, with penny-exact payouts and a printable tip-out sheet.

body.text: Tip-out math happens at closing time, when everyone is tired and the manager still has a restaurant to close. TipPool exists so splitting the night's tips takes a minute and the numbers always add up.

Enter the cash and card tips and your tip-out percentage for support staff. Add everyone on shift, mark them tipped or support, and set their hours. TipPool splits the pools by hours worked, rounds everything to the cent, and shows each person's share. Print a tip-out sheet for the night or save it to reload later.

items: Restaurant and bar managers closing out a shift
Shift leads splitting pooled tips by hours
Anyone dividing shared tips without an argument
Enter the night's cash and card tips
Set the tip-out percentage for support staff
Add each person with their role and hours
Print the tip-out sheet or save the night for your records

body.text: TipPool is $8 a month, or $40 for six months. Pay the admin, request your unlock PIN, and the tool opens up for your whole subscription.
